card.name: Warnings against rapid IV push
card.fires_on: Words inside warnings about not giving a drug by rapid, bolus or direct intravenous injection, such as RAPID, INTRAVENOUS, IV before BOLUS. It also fires weakly on other IV fluid and administration text.

modes.label: Rapid or bolus IV warnings
modes.description: Capitalised words in cautions against rapid or bolus intravenous injection.
modes.example: CISPLATIN SHOULD NOT BE GIVEN BY RAPID INTRAVEN<<OUS>> INJECTION.

modes.label: IV fluid and dilution text
modes.description: Numbers, punctuation and spaces inside diluent names, dilution volumes and section cross-references.
modes.example: 41 kg or more: 0.4 mL diluted with 0.4 mL of 0<<.>>9% Sodium Chloride Injection.

card.writes: It makes words like push, pushed and pushing more likely next, as in IV push.
card.plain: It notices warnings about giving a drug too fast or as a bolus, where the next word could be IV push.
